issues.t: Windshield pillar trim can come loose in a crash
issues.sym: Usually nothing until a crash. Sometimes the trim on the pillar beside the windshield looks loose or rattles.
issues.why: A clip holding the pillar trim could be faulty on early-build cars, so the trim could come off when the side curtain airbag fires.
issues.next: Check the VIN for Audi safety recall 70D4 and have the clip inspected at your next visit.

issues.sym: A rattle for a few seconds on cold start, a check engine light, misfires, or an engine that suddenly will not run.
issues.why: The tensioner that keeps the timing chain tight can let go, allowing the chain to jump. When that happens the valves and pistons can collide. A class settlement extended coverage on some of these years.
issues.next: If you hear a start-up rattle, stop driving and have the tensioner version checked. Replacing it early is far cheaper than an engine.

issues.sym: Low oil warnings well before the next service, needing to add oil regularly, and sometimes blue smoke or loss of power.
issues.why: The pistons and rings in this engine do not seal well enough, so oil gets past and is burned. Running low can damage the engine.
issues.next: Check the oil level every couple of fill-ups and have a dealer run a consumption test. Do not drive with the low oil warning on.

issues.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leak coolant
issues.sym: Coolant level dropping, a sweet smell, pink crust or drips at the front of the engine, or the temperature gauge climbing.
issues.why: The water pump and thermostat share a plastic housing that warps and seeps with heat and age.
issues.next: Have the leak confirmed soon and keep the coolant topped up. Stop driving if the temperature warning comes on.

issues.t: Sunroof drains leak and can corrode an airbag inflator
issues.sym: Wet headliner or water in the front pillar and footwell after rain, and sometimes a sunroof that stops working.
issues.why: The sunroof drain setup can let water into the roof pillar, where it soaks foam around the side curtain airbag inflator. The inflator canister can rust and rupture.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 17V-001. Have any water leak fixed promptly and the inflator inspected.

issues.t: Front sunroof glass can crack in extreme cold
issues.sym: A loud bang followed by a cracked or shattered front sunroof panel in very cold weather.
issues.why: The glass panel on vehicles built from mid to late 2011 could break when temperatures are very low. Audi recalled them to fit a new panel.
issues.next: Check the VIN for Audi safety recall 60B2. If the glass is cracked, keep the shade closed and have it replaced soon.

issues.t: Electric coolant pump can overheat and catch fire
issues.sym: Often no warning. Possible burning smell or smoke from under the hood, even with the vehicle parked.
issues.why: The small electric coolant pump can jam with debris or short out from moisture and overheat. The first recall changed software and the second replaces the pump.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 17V-002 and 18V-229. If open, have them done now and park outside until then.

issues.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak
issues.sym: Fuel smell around the rear of the vehicle or inside, mostly with a full tank.
issues.why: The plastic flange on top of the in-tank fuel pump can develop fine cracks that let fuel seep out. The recall replaces cracked flanges and covers sound ones with a protective film.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 16V-660 and its 2017 expansion (Audi code 20Z8). Leaking fuel is a fire risk, so do not put it off.

issues.t: Auxiliary heater connector can corrode and melt
issues.sym: Burning plastic smell from the vents, reduced cabin heat, or in rare cases smoke.
issues.why: The connector for the electric auxiliary heater can corrode, heat up and melt nearby wiring.
issues.next: Check the VIN for Audi safety recall 80C5 / 80C6. If you smell burning, turn the climate system off and have it inspected right away.

issues.t: Seat-mounted side airbag inflator can rupture
issues.sym: No symptom before a crash. In a crash the side airbag in the seat may not protect properly.
issues.why: Inflators in the seat side airbags on vehicles built in early 2015 could burst when deploying.
issues.next: Check the VIN for Audi safety recall 69M1 and have the airbag modules replaced if it is open.

issues.t: Vehicle can roll away in Park
issues.sym: The vehicle creeps or rolls after being shifted to Park if the parking brake is not set.
issues.why: A fault inside the gearbox on a small number of 2017 vehicles can keep the parking lock from holding.
issues.next: Check the VIN for Audi safety recall 37K6. Always set the parking brake until the recall is confirmed done.

issues.t: Airbags and seat belt tensioners may not fire
issues.sym: Usually no warning, though an airbag light may be on. In a crash the airbags or belt tensioners may not work.
issues.why: Some igniters in the airbags and seat belt pretensioners on early-build 2018 vehicles may not trigger properly.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the VIN for the open airbag recall and get the parts replaced before carrying passengers regularly.

issues.t: Valve cover bolts may be loose and leak oil
issues.sym: Oil smell, smoke from the engine bay or oil wetness around the top of the engine.
issues.why: The screws holding the cylinder head cover may not have been tightened correctly at the factory, so oil can escape onto hot parts.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 25V-294. If you smell burning oil or see smoke, stop and have it inspected because of the fire risk.
